lines.en: Don't look back — I'm there.

lines.zh: 我这条软虫，爬不了多远。
lines.en: A soft worm like me can't crawl far.
I cling to your calf.
Slime drags me along.
Each squirm leaves a wet mark.
The water on the ground is enough for me.
Who stepped on my tail?
Grass blackens where I crawl.
I leave a wet trail.

lines.zh: 月亮的影子压在我身上。
lines.en: The moon's shadow lies on me.
Living flesh smells ahead.

lines.zh: 别嫌我慢，我只有五滴血。
lines.en: Don't call me slow - I have only five health.
So quiet I can hear water moving.
The damp is drying right off me.
When I was alive, I could still swim.
The smell of blood has faded.
I'll rest stuck to a stone.

lines.zh: 水里泡着，忘了要做什么。
lines.en: Soaked in water, I forget my purpose.
I used to come to this pool every day.
Clinging still, I could stay all day.
The runes are still in my slime.
Mycelium on the bed grows with me.

lines.zh: 小水蛭仰起头，借我一只眼。
lines.en: A little leech looks up — lend me one eye.
Your wrist is pulsing.
There's blood-smell behind you.
I look up and borrow one of your eyes.
Warm, still steaming.
A five-point leech still drinks blood.
Don't run. I cling faster than wind.

lines.zh: 你皮肤下面有东西在流。
lines.en: Something flows beneath your skin.

lines.zh: 幽匿的水沟里，我先到了。
lines.en: I got to the sculk drain first.
Your blood murmurs under the skin.
Stop pressing. I'm stuck to you.
One arm gone; three left.

lines.zh: 我贴在你的腿上，吸一点算一点。
lines.en: I cling to your leg, sipping what I can.
Being stepped on hurt more when I was alive.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我的壳砸凹了。
lines.en: That one dented my shell.
Don't press that split.
Don't squeeze - I'll leak.
I'm soft, but hard to kill.
A little numbness. Not bad.

lines.zh: 水蛭的软身子被捏得凹了。
lines.en: The leech's soft body is squeezed concave.
A leech's mouth needs only a sip.
Five health, and I still bite.
Don't take it - let me lick it first.
Let me smell it. Just smell it.
One sip, and I follow you all the way.
Rot - my favorite when I was alive.
Five health, and I'll still bite.
Raw and slick - just my taste.
Sculk taste in the riverbed. Slow down.

lines.zh: 我的触须朝你伸过去了。
lines.en: My tendrils reach toward you.
Who kicked me?
Step on me and I'll stick to your boot.
Stepped on - my slime's leaking out.
In such a hurry to squash me?
Don't step in my slime.
Don't rub - I'm about to fall off.
Once I latch on, I don't come off.
Lift your foot. I'm under it.
Watch your step, living one.
Don't press - I'll flatten.
Hold hands? My hand's too slick.
I have no hands — how would I hold yours?

lines.zh: 我只有五点血，可我会吸。
lines.en: Five health, but I can drain.

lines.zh: 五滴血的身子，也能传菌。
lines.en: Five points of body can still spread it.

lines.zh: 我一小条，贴在石头上发抖。
lines.en: A little strip of me, shivering on the stone.
I'm too slick to hold you.
Drinking your blood is its own closeness.
Don't look - I'm missing a piece.
The living walk away; I never do.
A damp spot is good for leaning together.
I licked one of these when I was alive.
Something bright, stuck to me.
It slid right into my mouth.
This smells of living hands.
I'll hide it under wet mud.
Carry it back, bury it in sculk soil.
Dropped? Then it's mine.
Hold tight - I still want to suck it.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉，我抱着不撒手。
lines.en: I will not let go of this rotten flesh.
What use is this to me?

lines.zh: 我只有五点血，可我很饿。
lines.en: Five points of health, and very hungry.

lines.zh: 五点命的我，只会贴着你。
lines.en: Five points, and I cling to you.

lines.zh: 我这条水蛭，只有五点血。
lines.en: This leech has only five health.
Beneath those eyes, a vein pulses.
I tasted the water you stepped in.

lines.zh: 五点血的水蛭，只要一口。
lines.en: A leech with five health needs only one bite.
Once I cling, I don't come off.
That vein is mine.

lines.zh: 目标确认，幽匿水蛭贴上来。
lines.en: Target confirmed; the sculk leech attaches.
I've been hungry long enough.
Your blood is calling me.
Keep that leg still - I'm latching on.
I cling to stone and wait for warmth.
Your heartbeat is loud; I heard it.
I latch your ankle and won't let go.
Don't look back. I'm at your feet.
That ankle. That one.
I never sleep and never stop.
A leech moves an inch at a time.
In the water I follow and bite.
The leech slips into sculk cracks.
Don't go - let me latch on.

lines.zh: 贴着你的脚踝，吸一口算一口。
lines.en: Against your ankle, one sip counts as one.
Two more crawls and I'll reach you.
The sweat you leave behind is sweet.
Don't shake - I'm stuck tight.
Your blood runs faster than you.
I crawl along your footprints.
This small worm, I slip into cracks.
Run slowly; I follow your blood.
Light won't stop me; the damp will come.
I cling to the sculk and feed.
I hear your footsteps perfectly.
The more you run, the sweeter your blood.

lines.zh: 我只有五点血，可我会贴住你。
lines.en: Five points, and I still cling.
Soft things never tire.
Your ankle is mine now.
I nibble a small opening.
Only grazed the edge. Doesn't count.
Soft things bite too.
Move that foot. I'm passing.
One sip. Just one sip.
You flinched. I felt it.
Five health and I still bite.
I latch on and do not come off.
Once I suck, I don't let go.
Blood's seeping out. While it's warm.
Don't blame me. I'm hungry.
This mouth is only good for sucking.
One more bite and I'm full.
I've suctioned onto your wrist.
I slip into the seam of your boot.
Little strength, but a bite counts.

lines.zh: 幽匿的味道，天黑了才出来。
lines.en: Sculk's smell only comes out after dark.
I'm back — again.
Out of the wet mud, and still cold.
Anyone here? Blood smells close.
This puddle isn't my hollow.
In the sculk water, I hug the bottom.
Five drops of blood is enough to cling.
First thing on waking: find blood.
I've crawled out of the muck.
The altar's damp is back.
This slick skin again.
The damp soaked me awake.
I remember this hollow.
The soil loosened, so I squeezed out.
I'm smoking and curling up.
I writhe into a knot on the ground.

lines.zh: 沉进水里，我就不用爬了。
lines.en: Sinking means no more crawling.
The shockwave flung me into the dirt.
The arrow's in me; my slime seals it.
Light crawls under my skin.

lines.zh: 再吸不到，我这团就要散了。
lines.en: One more taste, or this clump comes apart.
Current runs through my slime.
Even slime can't grip the void.
